title: Hebrew
changes: The Studio is available in Hebrew at /he — every page has its own Hebrew address, so a link to a particular testimony can be sent to a Hebrew-reading visitor.
The page lays out right-to-left, with filenames, paths and numbers kept left-to-right inside Hebrew text.
A language link in the sidebar moves between the two versions of whichever page you are on.
The guided interview now asks its questions in the organisation's own Hebrew, taken verbatim from the Zikaron BaSalon testimony-givers kit rather than translated back from the English.

Translated so far: the navigation, the example stories, the testimony pages and the guided interview. The rest of the collection wizard is still English and falls back to it rather than rendering blank.
